messages:
Casey: Heads-up  we need one final SEO pass before the webinar goes live tomorrow. Focus: registration page, replay schema, and preserving UTMs for paid channels. Sheet: https://tiny.redwood/webinar-seo (internal)
Rina: main ask: include VideoObject schema for the recording so replay shows as a rich result. also add transcript markup after the event.
Malik: agree. also let's canonicalize querystring variants. canonical should be https://redwood.ai/webinar/production-inference. preserve utm as landing parameters but strip for canonical.
Gabe: tech note: we can implement a canonical + parameter handling like:
```
<link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://redwood.ai/webinar/production-inference\" />
# nginx: drop tracking params for upstream but keep them in GA/marketing layer
if ($args ~* \"(utm_|gclid|fbclid)\") {
  set $preserve_qs 1;
}
rewrite ^/webinar/production-inference$ /webinar/production-inference? permanent;
```
We should test in staging.
Rina: for VideoObject snippet (paste into head after canonical):
```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">\n{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"VideoObject","name":"Redwood Inference: Production Inference Webinar","description":"Demo + benchmarks for high-throughput LLM inference","thumbnailUrl":["https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/webinar-thumb.jpg"],"uploadDate":"2025-03-19","contentUrl":"https://cdn.redwood.ai/webinars/2025-production-inference.mp4","embedUrl":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/production-inference/embed"}
</script>
```
Casey: thanks. also: add markup for eventStatus: EventScheduled for live, then change to EventCancelled/EventPostponed if needed, and then to EventScheduled->EventSeries or keep as single event with VideoObject for replay.
product-marketing: CTA handling: registration thank-you page must be noindex, but the replay page should be indexable. ensure robots meta on /webinar/thanks is <meta name=\"robots\" content=\"noindex,follow\">\nMalik: redirect plan: legacy promos: /promo/inference-demo -> /webinar/production-inference (301). ensure we append src=promo if present. sample nginx rule:
```
rewrite ^/promo/inference-demo$ /webinar/production-inference?src=promo permanent;
```
Gabe: sitemap update needed: add <url><loc>https://redwood.ai/webinar/production-inference</loc><lastmod>2025-03-18</lastmod></url> and include video:video tags for video sitemap. I'll queue a sitemap-push after staging verification.
Casey: internal linking plan: add crosslinks from docs: /docs/serving/latency and blog: /blog/llm-benchmarks to the replay and registration page. anchor text suggestions: "production inference webinar replay", "LLM inference benchmarks", "reduce inference latency".
Rina: localization: we have FR and DE promos. add hreflang tags and localized VideoObject entries for each language variant. example: <link rel=\"alternate\" hreflang=\"fr\" href=\"https://redwood.ai/fr/webinar/production-inference\">\nMalik: tracking: keep UTM params intact for ad clicks so Paid -> Thank-you conversion works. but canonical must not include them. pass utm through server session to attribute conversions in GA.
SEO-Bot2: Fetch as Google requested for /webinar/production-inference :white_check_mark:
product-marketing: copy updates: tweaking H1 and meta description to include "low-latency LLM inference" + CTA for "Register now" and a short benchmark blurb for PR.
Casey: action owners: Gabe (sitemap + redirects), Malik (server param handling), Rina (schema + hreflang), product-marketing (copy), Casey (QA + GSC submit). I'll add these in the sheet and tag owners.
Gabe: reminder: thank-you email page should not be indexed but needs og:title/og:description for social shares from email previews. use meta robots noindex but full social tags.
Rina: post-event tasks: add transcript markup, caption file, and publish VideoObject with date and duration. schedule a follow-up issue for replay schema verification.
Malik: staging deploy tomorrow 06:30 PST, I'll coordinate with infra. please sign off in the sheet by EOD.
Casey: perfect. small note: we should run Lighthouse perf on the landing (LCP target <2.5s) and ensure JSON-LD <64kb. thanks everyone :rocket:
